pensionCalculator.title: National Pension Calculator
pensionCalculator.description: Enter just your age and monthly income to see your estimated pension, the contribution you and your employer pay each month, and your replacement rate. Continue to the detailed calculator for early/deferred claiming and credits.
pensionCalculator.notice: Present-value estimate assuming your current income stays the same, applying contribution-year coefficients (43% replacement rate from 2026) and the scheduled rate increase (13% by 2033). Contributions after 60 are assumed as voluntary continued coverage (up to 65). Actual benefits depend on income revaluation, contribution history and credits — check NPS for your exact amount.

formula.title: Pension Calculation Formula
items: Basic pension = coefficient × (A + B) × (1 + 5% per year beyond 20 years). The coefficient depends on the contribution year; periods from 2026 use 1.29 (43% replacement rate for 40 years)
A value = average monthly income of all subscribers over the 3 years before receipt (3,193,511 KRW, applied Dec 2025–Nov 2026)
B value = your average standard monthly income (cap 6.59M, floor 410K KRW, Jul 2026–Jun 2027)
With 10–20 years of coverage you get 50% of the basic pension plus 5% per year beyond 10 years; under 10 years you receive a lump-sum refund
This calculator assumes your current income stays constant and excludes dependent pension

contribution.title: Contribution Rate Guide
items: Total contribution rate: 9.5% of income in 2026 (rising 0.5%p a year to 13% in 2033 under the pension reform)
Regional and voluntary subscribers pay the full 9.5%
Standard monthly income cap 6.59M / floor 410K KRW (Jul 2026–Jun 2027; 6.37M / 400K in Jan–Jun 2026)

tips.title: How to Maximize Your Pension
items: Longer contribution periods increase your benefit (minimum 10 years, up to 40 years)
Voluntary or continued voluntary enrollment can extend your contribution period
Use the retroactive payment system to pay premiums for exemption periods
Military service, childbirth, and unemployment credits add to your contribution period
Higher income increases your B value, but the upper income limit applies
